rawContent: Listening to Terry Gilliam on @RTEArena. He says people in the #MeToo era are far too serious about everything. Which is an interesting take on rape and sexual abuse.

"Spock’s forced mind-meld with his traitorous protégé Valeris felt as horrible three decades before #MeToo as it does now. Psychic rape is just a metaphor, and it’s disturbing to watch Spock, a beloved, heroic character, overpower Valeris." #StarTrekPicard https://t.co/EoedgLVLok
